summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of Punto Cero One transformation. Verified HOME (/) at 1440 with LinkedIn-style Header (BrandMark, search, 8 nav items, gold Capital btn, notifications/messages/profile), primary SlideCarousel (pc-slider-primary) with 6 slides + prev/next + dots + autoplay progress bar, embedded team SlideCarousel (pc-slider-team) with prev/next/dots inside feed. Verified /capital renders 6 cards (exec, deck, strategy, room, portal, request) each linking to correct legacy routes. Regression on 7 legacy routes all returning 200 (or protected redirect for /investor-portal → /admin/login). Deck download PDF button present. Responsive verified at 375/768/1024/1440 with zero horizontal overflow; header-capital-btn visible at all breakpoints; header-mobile-toggle appears <900px and opens grid menu with mobile Capital btn. Zero console/page errors on / and /capital. Applied one fix: updated public/index.html <title> to 'Punto Cero One · Todo empieza aquí' (was 'Emergent | Fullstack App'). Favicon link points to Punto Cero One asset and resolves correctly.
action_items: Consider redirecting /investor-portal (unauth) to a dedicated investor login page instead of /admin/login (currently investor-portal → /admin/login). Behavior is technically 'protected redirect' but semantically inversores debería tener su propio login.
critical_code_review_comments: HomePage.jsx renders many heavy landing components inside AnimatePresence slider — all slides mount simultaneously via useMemo? Actually only active slide renders (AnimatePresence mode='wait'), OK. But on autoplay each transition mounts/unmounts full CircularCore/OrbitalEcosystem which are heavy; consider lazy or keeping mounted with visibility toggle to avoid jank.

SlideCarousel keyboard listener attached to window responds even when carousel is off-screen or another carousel is focused — two carousels present on HOME can both react to same ArrowRight/ArrowLeft key press. Scope listener to the section element (ref) or when hovered/focused only.
index.html title was still the template placeholder 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — fixed. Favicon link works but no <title> was PC-One branded; ensure future template changes don't reset it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Punto Cero One transformation acceptance criteria pass. Only nit: keyboard arrow listeners in SlideCarousel are global (window) which can cause double-navigation when both sliders are on the same page.
rca of the issue: Title bug RCA: public/index.html shipped with CRA default title 'Emergent | Fullstack App'. Fix: replaced with 'Punto Cero One · Todo empieza aquí' and restarted frontend.
